scripts.title: Button that opens a door
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Model in Workspace that holds two parts named Button and Door.
scripts.about: Clicking, tapping or stepping on the button opens the door for a few seconds.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local OPEN_TIME = 5 -- seconds the door stays open
local PRESSED_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0) -- button color while the door is open

local model = script.Parent
local button = model:WaitForChild("Button")
local door = model:WaitForChild("Door")

-- Add a ClickDetector so the button can be clicked or tapped
local clickDetector = button:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector") or Instance.new("ClickDetector")
clickDetector.Parent = button

local buttonColor = button.Color
local doorTransparency = door.Transparency
local isOpen = false

local function openDoor()
	if isOpen then
		return
	end
	isOpen = true
	button.Color = PRESSED_COLOR
	door.CanCollide = false
	door.Transparency = 0.8

	task.wait(OPEN_TIME)

	door.CanCollide = true
	door.Transparency = doorTransparency
	button.Color = buttonColor
	isOpen = false
end

-- Click or tap the button
clickDetector.MouseClick:Connect(openDoor)

-- Or step on the button
button.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent) then
		openDoor()
	end
end)

scripts.title: Door that opens when touched
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the door Part (make it Anchored).
scripts.about: The door opens when a player bumps into it, then closes again after a few seconds.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local OPEN_TIME = 3 -- seconds the door stays open
local OPEN_TRANSPARENCY = 0.7 -- how see-through it is when open (1 = invisible)

local door = script.Parent
local closedTransparency = door.Transparency
local isOpen = false

door.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	-- Only open for players, and not if it's already open
	if isOpen or not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent) then
		return
	end
	isOpen = true

	-- Open: you can walk through now
	door.CanCollide = false
	door.Transparency = OPEN_TRANSPARENCY

	task.wait(OPEN_TIME)

	-- Close again
	door.CanCollide = true
	door.Transparency = closedTransparency
	isOpen = false
end)

scripts.title: Key door
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the door Part, and make a Tool named Key (with a Handle part) that players can get.
scripts.about: The door only opens for players who have the Key tool.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these!
local KEY_NAME = "Key" -- the exact name of your key Tool
local OPEN_TIME = 3 -- seconds the door stays open
local USE_UP_KEY = false -- true = the key disappears after opening the door

local door = script.Parent
local closedTransparency = door.Transparency
local isOpen = false

-- Find the player who touched the door (even if it was their tool or hat)
local function getPlayer(hit)
	local model = hit.Parent
	local player = model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
	if not player and model and model.Parent then
		player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model.Parent)
	end
	return player
end

-- Look for the key in their hand or their backpack
local function findKey(player)
	local character = player.Character
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	return (character and character:FindFirstChild(KEY_NAME))
		or (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild(KEY_NAME))
end

door.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	if isOpen then
		return
	end
	local player = getPlayer(hit)
	local key = player and findKey(player)
	if not key then
		return -- no key, no entry!
	end

	isOpen = true
	if USE_UP_KEY then
		key:Destroy()
	end
	door.CanCollide = false
	door.Transparency = 0.7

	task.wait(OPEN_TIME)
	door.CanCollide = true
	door.Transparency = closedTransparency
	isOpen = false
end)

scripts.title: Team-only door
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the door Part, make sure you have Teams (in the Teams service), and set TEAM_NAME below.
scripts.about: Players on one team can walk right through the door, but everyone else is blocked.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local PhysicsService = game:GetService("PhysicsService")

-- Settings: change this to your team's exact name!
local TEAM_NAME = "Red"

local door = script.Parent
local doorGroup = "TeamDoor_" .. TEAM_NAME
local memberGroup = "TeamMembers_" .. TEAM_NAME

-- Collision groups: team members and this door don't bump into each other
for _, groupName in ipairs({ doorGroup, memberGroup }) do
	if not PhysicsService:IsCollisionGroupRegistered(groupName) then
		PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup(groupName)
	end
end
PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(doorGroup, memberGroup, false)
door.CollisionGroup = doorGroup

local function isOnTeam(player)
	return player.Team ~= nil and player.Team.Name == TEAM_NAME
end

-- Put a body part in the right group
local function updatePart(player, part)
	if not part:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end
	if isOnTeam(player) then
		part.CollisionGroup = memberGroup
	elseif part.CollisionGroup == memberGroup then
		part.CollisionGroup = "Default"
	end
end

local function updateCharacter(player, character)
	for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		updatePart(player, part)
	end
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	local function onCharacter(character)
		updateCharacter(player, character)
		character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(part)
			updatePart(player, part)
		end)
	end
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacter)
	if player.Character then
		onCharacter(player.Character)
	end
	-- Switching teams? Update right away
	player:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Team"):Connect(function()
		if player.Character then
			updateCharacter(player, player.Character)
		end
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	onPlayerAdded(player)
end

scripts.title: Coins on screen
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript inside a TextLabel in a ScreenGui in StarterGui (you also need the Leaderstats with saving script).
scripts.about: Shows the player's coins on the screen and updates it when the number changes.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these!
local STAT_NAME = "Coins" -- must match your leaderstats name
local PREFIX = "Coins: " -- text shown before the number

local label = script.Parent
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Wait for the leaderstats made by the server
local leaderstats = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats")
local stat = leaderstats:WaitForChild(STAT_NAME)

local function update()
	label.Text = PREFIX .. tostring(stat.Value)

update()
stat:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(update)

scripts.title: Shop button
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript inside a TextButton in a ScreenGui in StarterGui, and also add the Shop (server part) script and a RemoteEvent named BuyItem in ReplicatedStorage.
scripts.about: Tapping the button asks the server to buy an item, then shows if it worked.
scripts.code:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- Settings: change this to the item this button buys
local ITEM_NAME = "Sword" -- must match a name in the Shop (server part) PRICES list
local MESSAGE_TIME = 1.5 -- seconds the "Bought!" message stays

local button = script.Parent
local buyItem = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BuyItem")
local normalText = button.Text
local normalColor = button.BackgroundColor3
local messageNumber = 0

-- Tapping or clicking the button asks the server to buy (the server checks the coins)
button.Activated:Connect(function()
	buyItem:FireServer(ITEM_NAME)
end)

-- The server answers: did it work?
buyItem.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(itemName, success, message)
	if itemName ~= ITEM_NAME then
		return -- this answer is for a different button
	end
	messageNumber = messageNumber + 1
	local myNumber = messageNumber

	button.Text = message
	if success then
		button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 200, 90) -- green
	else
		button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 70, 70) -- red
	end

	-- Go back to normal after a moment
	task.delay(MESSAGE_TIME, function()
		if myNumber == messageNumber then
			button.Text = normalText
			button.BackgroundColor3 = normalColor
		end
	end)
end)

scripts.title: Round timer with intermission
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService; add a normal Part named RoundSpawn where rounds start (not a SpawnLocation), and use the Round timer text script to show the time.
scripts.about: Runs an intermission countdown, sends everyone into a round, then brings them back to the lobby, forever.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local INTERMISSION = 15 -- seconds in the lobby between rounds
local ROUND_TIME = 60 -- seconds each round lasts
local MIN_PLAYERS = 1 -- players needed to start (use 2 for a real game)

-- The text everyone sees, shared in ReplicatedStorage
local status = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Status")
if not status then
	status = Instance.new("StringValue")
	status.Name = "Status"
	status.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

-- Count down one second at a time
local function countdown(text, seconds)
	for i = seconds, 1, -1 do
		status.Value = text .. i
		task.wait(1)
	end
end

while true do
	-- Wait until there are enough players
	while #Players:GetPlayers() < MIN_PLAYERS do
		status.Value = "Waiting for players..."
		task.wait(1)
	end

	countdown("Intermission: ", INTERMISSION)

	-- Round start: send everyone to RoundSpawn (spread out a little)
	local roundSpawn = workspace:FindFirstChild("RoundSpawn")
	if roundSpawn then
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local character = player.Character
			if character then
				local offset = Vector3.new(math.random(-5, 5), 5, math.random(-5, 5))
				character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(roundSpawn.Position + offset))
			end
		end
	end

	countdown("Round: ", ROUND_TIME)

	-- Round over: respawn everyone back in the lobby
	status.Value = "Round over!"
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		player:LoadCharacter()
	end
	task.wait(3)
end

scripts.title: Win pad
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the finish Part at the end of your obby or race, and add a Part named Lobby in Workspace if you want winners sent back there.
scripts.about: Touching the finish gives the player a Win on the leaderboard and sends them back to the lobby.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these!
local LOBBY_NAME = "Lobby" -- winners get sent to a part with this name (if it exists)
local COOLDOWN = 5 -- seconds before the same player can win again

local pad = script.Parent
local recent = {} -- players who just won

pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	if not player or recent[player] then
		return
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end
	recent[player] = true

	-- Find (or make) the Wins number on the leaderboard
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
		leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
		leaderstats.Parent = player
	end
	local wins = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Wins")
	if not wins then
		wins = Instance.new("IntValue")
		wins.Name = "Wins"
		wins.Parent = leaderstats
	end
	wins.Value = wins.Value + 1

	-- Send the winner back to the lobby
	local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild(LOBBY_NAME)
	if lobby and lobby:IsA("BasePart") then
		character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(lobby.Position + Vector3.new(0, lobby.Size.Y / 2 + 3, 0)))
	end

	task.delay(COOLDOWN, function()
		recent[player] = nil
	end)
end)

scripts.title: Conveyor belt
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a flat Part; it pushes players toward the part's Front side (spin the part around to change the direction).
scripts.about: Pushes anything standing on the part along, like a conveyor belt.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change this number!
local SPEED = 10 -- studs per second (bigger = faster, negative = backwards)

local belt = script.Parent
belt.Anchored = true -- the belt itself stays still

-- The belt "pretends" to move, so things on top slide along
local function updateBelt()
	belt.AssemblyLinearVelocity = belt.CFrame.LookVector * SPEED
end

updateBelt()
-- If you turn the part around while playing, the push direction follows
belt:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"):Connect(updateBelt)

scripts.title: Moving platform
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the Part you want to slide back and forth (it will be Anchored for you).
keywords: part that goes back and forth
scripts.about: Slides the part back and forth forever, and players standing on it ride along.
scripts.code:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local MOVE_BY = Vector3.new(0, 0, 20) -- how far it moves (X, Y, Z in studs)
local TIME = 3 -- seconds to move one way (smaller = faster)

local part = script.Parent
part.Anchored = true
local startPosition = part.Position

-- Slide to the end, then back again, forever (-1 = repeat forever, true = go back)
local info = TweenInfo.new(TIME, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true)
local tween = TweenService:Create(part, info, { Position = startPosition + MOVE_BY })
tween:Play()

-- This tells physics how fast the part moves, so players on top ride along
local lastPosition = part.Position
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	local nowPosition = part.Position
	if dt > 0 then
		part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = (nowPosition - lastPosition) / dt
	end
	lastPosition = nowPosition
end)

scripts.title: Spinning part
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the Part you want to spin (it will be Anchored for you).
scripts.about: Spins the part around and around, and pushes players it hits.
scripts.code:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SPEED = 90 -- degrees per second (bigger = faster, negative = other way)
local AXIS = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) -- spin around: (0,1,0) = flat like a fan, (1,0,0) = like a wheel

local part = script.Parent
part.Anchored = true

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	-- Turn a tiny bit every frame
	part.CFrame = part.CFrame * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(AXIS, math.rad(SPEED) * dt)
	-- Tell physics it's spinning, so it pushes players instead of sliding under them
	part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = part.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(AXIS) * math.rad(SPEED)
end)

scripts.title: Checkpoints
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService, then make a Folder named Checkpoints in Workspace with SpawnLocations inside named 1, 2, 3 and so on (1 is the start).
scripts.about: Touching a checkpoint makes it the place where you come back to life.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local checkpoints = workspace:WaitForChild("Checkpoints")
local best = {} -- the highest checkpoint each player reached

-- Get ready a checkpoint so touching it saves your spot
local function setupCheckpoint(checkpoint)
	if not checkpoint:IsA("SpawnLocation") then
		return
	end
	checkpoint.Neutral = true -- everyone can use it, any team

	checkpoint.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
		local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
		local number = tonumber(checkpoint.Name)
		if not player or not number then
			return
		end
		-- Only save if it's further than before (no going back!)
		if number > (best[player] or 0) then
			best[player] = number
			player.RespawnLocation = checkpoint
		end
	end)
end

for _, checkpoint in ipairs(checkpoints:GetChildren()) do
	setupCheckpoint(checkpoint)
end
checkpoints.ChildAdded:Connect(setupCheckpoint)

-- New players start at checkpoint 1
local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	local first = checkpoints:FindFirstChild("1")
	if first and first:IsA("SpawnLocation") then
		best[player] = 1
		player.RespawnLocation = first
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	onPlayerAdded(player)
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	best[player] = nil
end)

scripts.title: Damage zone
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Part that covers the hurting area (turn off CanCollide and make it see-through if you like).
scripts.about: Players standing inside the zone keep losing health a little at a time.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local DAMAGE = 10 -- health lost each tick
local TICK_TIME = 1 -- seconds between ticks

local zone = script.Parent

-- Only look at things that are not the zone itself
local params = OverlapParams.new()
params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { zone }

while true do
	task.wait(TICK_TIME)

	-- Find every player character inside the zone (each one only once)
	local hurt = {}
	for _, hit in ipairs(workspace:GetPartsInPart(zone, params)) do
		local character = hit.Parent
		local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
		if player and not hurt[player] then
			hurt[player] = true
			local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
				humanoid:TakeDamage(DAMAGE)
			end
		end
	end
end

scripts.title: Disappearing platform
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the platform Part that should fade away when someone steps on it.
scripts.about: The platform fades away after someone steps on it, then comes back.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local WAIT_BEFORE_FADE = 0.5 -- seconds before it starts fading
local FADE_TIME = 1 -- seconds it takes to fade out
local COME_BACK_TIME = 3 -- seconds before it comes back

local part = script.Parent
local startTransparency = part.Transparency
local busy = false

local function fadeTo(transparency)
	local tween = TweenService:Create(part, TweenInfo.new(FADE_TIME), { Transparency = transparency })
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Wait()
end

part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	-- Only players start the fade, and only once at a time
	if busy or not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent) then
		return
	end
	busy = true

	task.wait(WAIT_BEFORE_FADE)
	fadeTo(1)
	part.CanCollide = false -- now you fall through!

	task.wait(COME_BACK_TIME)
	part.CanCollide = true
	fadeTo(startTransparency)
	busy = false
end)

scripts.title: Fall kill height
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService.
scripts.about: Anyone who falls below a set height gets reset.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local KILL_HEIGHT = -50 -- fall lower than this Y position and you reset
local CHECK_EVERY = 0.25 -- seconds between checks

while true do
	task.wait(CHECK_EVERY)

	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local character = player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		-- Too low? Reset them!
		if root and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and root.Position.Y < KILL_HEIGHT then
			humanoid.Health = 0
		end
	end
end

scripts.title: Kill brick
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the Part you want to be deadly.
scripts.about: Touching the part resets the player.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local part = script.Parent

-- When something touches the part...
part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	-- ...check if it belongs to a player's character
	local character = hit.Parent
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	if not player then
		return
	end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
		humanoid.Health = 0 -- Oof! Back to spawn.
	end
end)

scripts.title: Obby stage counter
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService, and make a Folder named Checkpoints in Workspace with parts inside named 1, 2, 3 and so on (works great with the Checkpoints script).
scripts.about: Shows each player's obby stage on the leaderboard and raises it when they reach a new stage.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: set to true so players can't skip stages
local ONLY_NEXT_STAGE = false

local checkpoints = workspace:WaitForChild("Checkpoints")

-- Make the Stage number on the leaderboard
local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
		leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats" -- must be lowercase like this!
		leaderstats.Parent = player
	end
	local stage = Instance.new("IntValue")
	stage.Name = "Stage"
	stage.Value = 0
	stage.Parent = leaderstats
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	onPlayerAdded(player)
end

-- Touching a stage part raises your Stage number
local function setupStage(part)
	if not part:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end
	part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
		local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
		local number = tonumber(part.Name)
		local leaderstats = player and player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		local stage = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Stage")
		if not stage or not number then
			return
		end
		if ONLY_NEXT_STAGE then
			if number == stage.Value + 1 then
				stage.Value = number
			end
		elseif number > stage.Value then
			stage.Value = number
		end
	end)
end

for _, part in ipairs(checkpoints:GetChildren()) do
	setupStage(part)
end
checkpoints.ChildAdded:Connect(setupStage)

scripts.title: Rising lava
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a big flat lava Part placed at the bottom of your map (make it Anchored).
scripts.about: The lava slowly rises up, kills anyone it touches, then drops back down and starts again.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local RISE_SPEED = 2 -- studs per second (bigger = faster)
local RISE_HEIGHT = 100 -- how many studs the lava climbs
local WAIT_AT_TOP = 5 -- seconds it stays at the top
local WAIT_AT_BOTTOM = 5 -- seconds before it rises again

local lava = script.Parent
lava.Anchored = true
local startCFrame = lava.CFrame

-- Touching the lava resets the player
lava.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	if not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character) then
		return
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
		humanoid.Health = 0
	end
end)

while true do
	task.wait(WAIT_AT_BOTTOM)

	-- Rise a little bit every frame
	local risen = 0
	while risen < RISE_HEIGHT do
		local dt = RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
		risen = math.min(risen + RISE_SPEED * dt, RISE_HEIGHT)
		lava.CFrame = startCFrame + Vector3.new(0, risen, 0)
	end

	task.wait(WAIT_AT_TOP)
	lava.CFrame = startCFrame -- back to the bottom
end

scripts.title: Coin pickup
scripts.where: Put this Script inside your coin Part, and add the Leaderstats with saving script to ServerScriptService so players have Coins.
scripts.about: Touching the coin gives the player coins, then the coin comes back after a few seconds.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local COINS = 1 -- coins you get each time
local RESPAWN_TIME = 5 -- seconds before the coin comes back
local SPIN_SPEED = 90 -- degrees per second (0 = no spinning)
local STAT_NAME = "Coins" -- must match your leaderstats name

local coin = script.Parent
coin.Anchored = true
coin.CanCollide = false
local startTransparency = coin.Transparency
local collected = false

coin.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	if collected then
		return
	end
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
	local leaderstats = player and player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coins = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild(STAT_NAME)
	if not coins then
		return
	end

	-- Give the coins and hide the coin
	collected = true
	coins.Value = coins.Value + COINS
	coin.Transparency = 1

	-- Bring it back later
	task.wait(RESPAWN_TIME)
	coin.Transparency = startTransparency
	collected = false
end)

-- Spin around and around (straight up and down, no matter how the coin is turned)
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	if SPIN_SPEED ~= 0 then
		local turn = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(SPIN_SPEED) * dt, 0)
		coin.CFrame = CFrame.new(coin.Position) * turn * (coin.CFrame - coin.Position)
	end
end)

scripts.title: Coins over time
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService, together with the Leaderstats with saving script.
scripts.about: Gives every player some coins every so often just for being in the game.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these!
local AMOUNT = 10 -- coins given each time
local EVERY = 60 -- seconds between payouts
local STAT_NAME = "Coins" -- must match your leaderstats name

while true do
	task.wait(EVERY)

	-- Pay everyone in the server
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		local coins = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild(STAT_NAME)
		if coins then
			coins.Value = coins.Value + AMOUNT
		end
	end
end

scripts.title: Leaderstats with saving
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService, and to test saving in Studio turn on Game Settings > Security > Enable Studio Access to API Services.
scripts.about: Adds a Coins number to the leaderboard and saves it, so players keep their coins next time they play.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

-- Settings: change these!
local STAT_NAME = "Coins" -- the name shown on the leaderboard
local START_AMOUNT = 0 -- coins a brand new player gets
local AUTOSAVE_EVERY = 120 -- seconds between autosaves

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerCoins_v1")
local loaded = {} -- only save players whose coins loaded fine, so we never wipe them

local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	-- The folder MUST be named "leaderstats" (all lowercase)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") or Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player
	local stat = Instance.new("IntValue")
	stat.Name = STAT_NAME
	stat.Value = START_AMOUNT
	stat.Parent = leaderstats

	-- Load saved coins (pcall stops errors from breaking the script)
	local ok, saved = pcall(function()
		return store:GetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId)
	end)
	if ok and player.Parent then
		if typeof(saved) == "number" then
			stat.Value = saved
		end
		loaded[player] = true
	elseif not ok then
		warn("Could not load coins for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. tostring(saved))
	end
end

local function save(player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local stat = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild(STAT_NAME)
	if not loaded[player] or not stat then return end
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		store:SetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, stat.Value)
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("Could not save coins for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. tostring(err))
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
end

-- Save when a player leaves
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	save(player)
	loaded[player] = nil
end)

-- Save everyone when the server shuts down
game:BindToClose(function()
	local left = 0
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		left = left + 1
		task.spawn(function()
			save(player)
			left = left - 1
		end)
	end
	while left > 0 do task.wait() end
end)

-- Autosave every few minutes, just in case
while true do
	task.wait(AUTOSAVE_EVERY)
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		task.spawn(save, player)
	end
end

scripts.title: Shop (server part)
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService, add a RemoteEvent named BuyItem to ReplicatedStorage, and put your Tools in a Folder named ShopItems in ServerStorage.
scripts.about: Checks a player has enough coins, takes them, and gives the Tool they bought (use it with the Shop button script).
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

-- Settings: item names and prices (each name must match a Tool in ShopItems)
local PRICES = {
	["Sword"] = 50,
	["Speed Coil"] = 100,
}
local STAT_NAME = "Coins"
local COOLDOWN = 1 -- seconds between buys (stops button spamming)

local buyItem = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("BuyItem")
local shopItems = ServerStorage:WaitForChild("ShopItems")
local lastBuy = {}

-- Does the player already own this tool?
local function ownsTool(player, name)
	local gear = player:FindFirstChild("StarterGear")
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	local character = player.Character
	return (gear and gear:FindFirstChild(name))
		or (backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild(name))
		or (character and character:FindFirstChild(name))
end

buyItem.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, itemName)
	-- Never trust the client: the server checks everything!
	if typeof(itemName) ~= "string" then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastBuy[player] and now - lastBuy[player] < COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	lastBuy[player] = now

	local price = PRICES[itemName]
	local tool = shopItems:FindFirstChild(itemName)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coins = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild(STAT_NAME)
	if not price or not tool or not coins then
		buyItem:FireClient(player, itemName, false, "Not for sale")
	elseif ownsTool(player, itemName) then
		buyItem:FireClient(player, itemName, false, "You have it!")
	elseif coins.Value < price then
		buyItem:FireClient(player, itemName, false, "Need " .. price .. " coins")
	else
		-- Take the coins and give the tool (StarterGear keeps it after you respawn)
		coins.Value = coins.Value - price
		local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
		if backpack then
			tool:Clone().Parent = backpack
		end
		local gear = player:FindFirstChild("StarterGear")
		if gear then
			tool:Clone().Parent = gear
		end
		buyItem:FireClient(player, itemName, true, "Bought!")
	end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	lastBuy[player] = nil
end)

scripts.title: Double jump
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts.
scripts.about: Lets players jump a second time while they are in the air (works with the jump button on phones and iPads too).
scripts.code:
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local DOUBLE_JUMP_POWER = 50 -- how high the second jump goes
local DELAY = 0.2 -- seconds after leaving the ground before you can jump again

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local leftGroundAt = nil -- when we left the ground
local usedDoubleJump = false

-- Keep track of when we are on the ground or in the air
humanoid.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, newState)
	if newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed
		or newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running
		or newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing
		or newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming then
		leftGroundAt = nil
		usedDoubleJump = false
	elseif newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall or newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
		if not leftGroundAt then
			leftGroundAt = os.clock()
		end
	end
end)

-- When the player presses jump in the air, jump again (only once!)
UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
	if usedDoubleJump or not leftGroundAt then
		return
	end
	if os.clock() - leftGroundAt < DELAY then
		return
	end
	if humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
		return
	end

	usedDoubleJump = true
	humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
	local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(velocity.X, DOUBLE_JUMP_POWER, velocity.Z)
end)

scripts.title: Healing pad
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the Part you want to heal players.
scripts.about: Gives players health back when they touch it, with a wait before it works again.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local HEAL_AMOUNT = 25 -- health given each time
local COOLDOWN = 5 -- seconds before the same player can heal again

local pad = script.Parent
local lastHeal = {} -- when each player last healed

pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	if not player then
		return
	end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	-- Skip if they're gone, or already at full health
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.Health >= humanoid.MaxHealth then
		return
	end

	-- Still cooling down? Not yet!
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastHeal[player] and now - lastHeal[player] < COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	lastHeal[player] = now

	-- Heal, but never above max health
	humanoid.Health = math.min(humanoid.Health + HEAL_AMOUNT, humanoid.MaxHealth)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	lastHeal[player] = nil
end)

scripts.title: Jump pad
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the Part you want to be a jump pad.
scripts.about: Launches players high into the air when they step on it.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local JUMP_POWER = 100 -- how fast you shoot up (bigger = higher)
local COOLDOWN = 0.5 -- seconds before the same player can bounce again

local pad = script.Parent
local recent = {} -- players who just bounced

pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	if not player or recent[player] then
		return
	end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or not root or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end

	recent[player] = true
	-- Keep sideways speed, but shoot straight up!
	local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(velocity.X, JUMP_POWER, velocity.Z)

	task.delay(COOLDOWN, function()
		recent[player] = nil
	end)
end)

scripts.title: Speed pad
scripts.where: Put this Script inside the Part you want to be a speed pad.
scripts.about: Makes players super fast for a few seconds, then back to normal speed.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local BOOST_SPEED = 50 -- speed while boosted
local NORMAL_SPEED = 16 -- normal Roblox speed is 16
local BOOST_TIME = 3 -- seconds the boost lasts

local pad = script.Parent
local boosted = {} -- players who are boosted right now

pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	if not player or boosted[player] then
		return
	end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end

	-- Zoom!
	boosted[player] = true
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = BOOST_SPEED

	-- After a few seconds, go back to normal
	task.delay(BOOST_TIME, function()
		if humanoid.Parent then
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = NORMAL_SPEED
		end
		boosted[player] = nil
	end)
end)

scripts.title: Sprint button
scripts.where: Put this LocalScript in StarterPlayer > StarterCharacterScripts.
scripts.about: Hold Shift (or the Run button on phones and iPads) to run faster.
scripts.code:
local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SPRINT_SPEED = 28 -- speed while sprinting
local WALK_SPEED = 16 -- normal speed

local character = script.Parent
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

-- Runs when the sprint key or button is pressed or let go
local function onSprint(_, inputState)
	if inputState == Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = SPRINT_SPEED
	elseif inputState == Enum.UserInputState.End or inputState == Enum.UserInputState.Cancel then
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = WALK_SPEED
	end
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
end

-- true = also make a button on touch screens
ContextActionService:BindAction("Sprint", onSprint, true, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift, Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL3)
ContextActionService:SetTitle("Sprint", "Run")

-- Remove the button when you die (a new one comes when you respawn)
humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
	ContextActionService:UnbindAction("Sprint")
end)

scripts.title: Teleporter pair
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Model or Folder in Workspace that holds two parts named TeleportA and TeleportB.
scripts.about: Touching one pad sends you to the other pad, and back again.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change this number!
local COOLDOWN = 2 -- seconds before you can teleport again (stops bouncing back and forth)

local holder = script.Parent
local padA = holder:WaitForChild("TeleportA")
local padB = holder:WaitForChild("TeleportB")
local recent = {} -- players who just teleported

-- Touching fromPad sends you on top of toPad
local function linkPads(fromPad, toPad)
	fromPad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
		local character = hit.Parent
		local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
		if not player or recent[player] then
			return
		end
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			return
		end

		recent[player] = true
		-- Land a little above the other pad
		local above = toPad.Position + Vector3.new(0, toPad.Size.Y / 2 + 3, 0)
		character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(above))

		task.delay(COOLDOWN, function()
			recent[player] = nil
		end)
	end)
end

linkPads(padA, padB)
linkPads(padB, padA)

scripts.title: Basic sword
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Tool that has a part named Handle, then put the Tool in StarterPack.
scripts.about: Click or tap to swing the sword and hurt other players and NPCs it hits (never yourself).
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local DAMAGE = 25 -- health taken per hit
local SWING_TIME = 0.4 -- seconds a swing can hit things
local COOLDOWN = 0.8 -- seconds between swings
local TEAM_DAMAGE = false -- true = you can hurt your own team

local tool = script.Parent
local handle = tool:WaitForChild("Handle")
local swinging = false
local canSwing = true
local hitThisSwing = {} -- each enemy can only be hit once per swing

tool.Activated:Connect(function()
	if not canSwing then
		return
	end
	canSwing = false
	swinging = true
	hitThisSwing = {}

	-- Play Roblox's built-in sword slash animation
	local anim = Instance.new("StringValue")
	anim.Name = "toolanim"
	anim.Value = "Slash"
	anim.Parent = tool

	task.wait(SWING_TIME)
	swinging = false
	task.wait(math.max(COOLDOWN - SWING_TIME, 0))
	canSwing = true
end)

handle.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	if not swinging then
		return
	end
	local owner = tool.Parent -- the character holding the sword
	local character = hit.Parent
	if not character or character == owner then
		return -- no hitting yourself!
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or hitThisSwing[humanoid] then
		return
	end

	-- Skip teammates (only if your game has teams)
	local ownerPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(owner)
	local victimPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	if not TEAM_DAMAGE and ownerPlayer and victimPlayer and victimPlayer.Team ~= nil
		and victimPlayer.Team == ownerPlayer.Team then
		return
	end

	hitThisSwing[humanoid] = true
	humanoid:TakeDamage(DAMAGE)
end)

scripts.title: Click to get a tool
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Part, and put the Tool you want to give in ServerStorage (set TOOL_NAME to its exact name).
scripts.about: Clicking or tapping the part puts a copy of the tool in the player's backpack.
scripts.code:
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

-- Settings: change these!
local TOOL_NAME = "Sword" -- the exact name of the Tool in ServerStorage
local CLICK_DISTANCE = 20 -- how close you must be to click it

local part = script.Parent

-- Add a ClickDetector so the part can be clicked or tapped
local clickDetector = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector") or Instance.new("ClickDetector")
clickDetector.MaxActivationDistance = CLICK_DISTANCE
clickDetector.Parent = part

clickDetector.MouseClick:Connect(function(player)
	local tool = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild(TOOL_NAME)
	if not tool then
		warn("Put a Tool named " .. TOOL_NAME .. " in ServerStorage!")
		return
	end

	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	local character = player.Character
	if not backpack then
		return
	end

	-- Only one each, no stacking up copies
	if backpack:FindFirstChild(TOOL_NAME) or (character and character:FindFirstChild(TOOL_NAME)) then
		return
	end

	tool:Clone().Parent = backpack
end)

scripts.title: Day and night cycle
scripts.where: Put this Script in ServerScriptService.
scripts.about: Makes the sun move across the sky so day turns into night and back again.
scripts.code:
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

-- Settings: change these numbers!
local DAY_LENGTH = 10 -- minutes for one full day and night
local START_TIME = 8 -- the hour the game starts at (0 = midnight, 12 = noon)
local UPDATE_EVERY = 0.1 -- seconds between updates

Lighting.ClockTime = START_TIME

-- How many in-game hours pass each real second
local hoursPerSecond = 24 / (DAY_LENGTH * 60)

while true do
	local dt = task.wait(UPDATE_EVERY)
	-- Move the clock forward (% 24 makes it go back to 0 after midnight)
	Lighting.ClockTime = (Lighting.ClockTime + hoursPerSecond * dt) % 24
end

scripts.title: NPC that follows players
scripts.where: Put this Script inside an NPC Model that has a Humanoid and a HumanoidRootPart (for example a Rig made with the Rig Builder in the Avatar tab).
scripts.about: The NPC walks after the nearest player, and can hurt them if you turn on TOUCH_DAMAGE.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")

-- Settings: change these!
local CHASE_DISTANCE = 100 -- players closer than this get followed
local STOP_DISTANCE = 5 -- stop walking this close to the player
local USE_PATHFINDING = false -- true = walks around walls
local TOUCH_DAMAGE = 0 -- set to 10 to make it a zombie that hurts

local npc = script.Parent
local humanoid = npc:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local root = npc:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
-- Unanchor the NPC so it can walk, and let the server move it smoothly
for _, part in ipairs(npc:GetDescendants()) do
	if part:IsA("BasePart") then
		part.Anchored = false
	end
end
pcall(function() root:SetNetworkOwner(nil) end)

-- Find the closest living player
local function findNearest()
	local nearest, nearestDistance = nil, CHASE_DISTANCE
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local character = player.Character
		local theirRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local theirHumanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if theirRoot and theirHumanoid and theirHumanoid.Health > 0 then
			local distance = (theirRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
			if distance < nearestDistance then
				nearest, nearestDistance = theirRoot, distance
			end
		end
	end
	return nearest, nearestDistance
end

-- Walk toward a spot (around walls if pathfinding is on)
local function walkTo(position)
	if USE_PATHFINDING then
		local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath()
		local ok = pcall(function()
			path:ComputeAsync(root.Position, position)
		end)
		local waypoints = ok and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success and path:GetWaypoints()
		local nextPoint = waypoints and (waypoints[2] or waypoints[1])
		if nextPoint then
			if nextPoint.Action == Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then
				humanoid.Jump = true
			end
			humanoid:MoveTo(nextPoint.Position)
			return
		end
	end
	humanoid:MoveTo(position)
end

-- Hurt players it touches (only if TOUCH_DAMAGE is more than 0)
local lastHit = {}
humanoid.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
	local theirHumanoid = player and hit.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local now = os.clock()
	-- Only hurt the same player once per second
	if TOUCH_DAMAGE > 0 and theirHumanoid and now - (lastHit[player] or 0) >= 1 then
		lastHit[player] = now
		theirHumanoid:TakeDamage(TOUCH_DAMAGE)
	end
end)

-- Keep chasing while the NPC is alive
while humanoid.Health > 0 do
	local target, distance = findNearest()
	if target and distance > STOP_DISTANCE then
		walkTo(target.Position)
	end
	task.wait(0.25)
end

scripts.title: Rainbow part
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Part (or inside a Model to make every part in it rainbow).
scripts.about: Smoothly changes the color through the whole rainbow, over and over.
scripts.code:
-- Settings: change these numbers!
local SPEED = 0.2 -- how fast the colors change (1 = whole rainbow every second)
local SATURATION = 1 -- 0 = grey, 1 = super colorful
local BRIGHTNESS = 1 -- 0 = black, 1 = bright

local target = script.Parent
local hue = 0

-- Color the part, or every part inside the model
local function paint(color)
	if target:IsA("BasePart") then
		target.Color = color
	end
	for _, item in ipairs(target:GetDescendants()) do
		if item:IsA("BasePart") then
			item.Color = color
		end
	end
end

while true do
	local dt = task.wait(0.05)
	hue = (hue + SPEED * dt) % 1
	paint(Color3.fromHSV(hue, SATURATION, BRIGHTNESS))
end

scripts.title: Sound on touch
scripts.where: Put this Script inside a Part, and put a Sound inside the same Part (pick one from the Toolbox or paste a sound ID into its SoundId).
keywords: noise when you step on it
scripts.about: Plays the part's sound when a player touches it.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Settings: change this number!
local COOLDOWN = 1 -- seconds before the same player can play it again

local part = script.Parent
local sound = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sound")
local lastPlayed = {}

if not sound then
	warn("Put a Sound inside " .. part.Name .. " so it has something to play!")
	return
end

part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
	if not player then
		return
	end

	-- Wait a bit between plays so it doesn't spam
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastPlayed[player] and now - lastPlayed[player] < COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	lastPlayed[player] = now

	sound:Play()
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	lastPlayed[player] = nil
end)
